purpose: Explainable identity-aware phishing URL risk core
core_principles: Identity conflict is neutral with respect to phishing
Verified identity is not an allowlist
Supported identity is not an allowlist
Independent malicious evidence survives trusted identity
Impersonation requires corroboration before identity-based escalation
Shared legitimate web presence is not treated as conflicting ownership
known_limitations: 11.67% phishing recall is not production-grade coverage
Current benchmark is a limited 500 benign / 300 phishing holdout
Core v1 does not represent the full investigation capabilities of the platform
Future intelligence should be orchestrated by the analyst layer rather than added as ad-hoc URL scoring rules
